summary_en: The paper proposes data-adaptive pattern-coupled Bayesian compressive sensing for sparse sound-field reconstruction within an equivalent-source near-field acoustic holography framework. Learnable coupling among sparsity hyperparameters adapts to non-uniform spatial correlations, improving reconstruction accuracy and robustness without requiring a predefined block structure.

summary_en: This work formulates sparse-view PACT reconstruction as a continuous implicit neural representation of the initial heat distribution. A coordinate MLP is optimized self-supervised by matching measured and forward-model-predicted photoacoustic signals, reducing sparse-view artifacts and improving image fidelity relative to UBP and conventional model-based reconstruction.

summary_en: The paper introduces a non-iterative patch near-field acoustic holography method based on Natural Neighbor Interpolation. It targets limited-aperture truncation artifacts, producing smoother field extrapolation and improved reconstruction accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost compared with iterative Papoulis-Gerchberg-style patch methods.
